records.rule: Patient mapping commits before alias processing.
Alias, contact and demographic outcomes are independent child reconciliations.
Duplicate-withheld alias does not block valid contact or demographic outcomes.
Patient quarantine blocks alias persistence and every Phase 2D child.
created_by is null with protected absence provenance; source_patient_id is null.
Existing aliases, patient numbers and owners are never changed, transferred, deleted or recycled.
OriginalName and OriginalOpd create no alias; nonblank drift stops semantic review.
No Phase 2D canonicalizer, collision rule or duplicate-owner rule is permitted.
No contact or demographic similarity influences alias ownership or patient identity.
Phase 2D creates zero alias rows; future persistence consumes Phase 2C only.
